summary: Candidate is a distinct safety_rule at session granularity addressing exactly-once semantics validation for file sources. It does not match any existing skill in asset_type, granularity, task_family, or semantic capability. Peer candidates (File-based Data Source Configuration, Collection-based Data Source Creation, Buffer Timeout Configuration) are either broader session_skills or address different constraints (buffer timeout). The candidate fills a gap: enforcing semantic compatibility at configuration validation time before source activation. No merge, split, or revision relationship exists with existing skills.
